headline: South African Reserve Bank Expected to Keep Repo Rate Steady
summary: Economists anticipate the South African Reserve Bank will hold its policy rate unchanged, though market forecasters warn interest rate increases could resume in 2027.
why: The SARB's benchmark repo rate sets monetary conditions across Africa's most developed financial market.

impacts.name: South African Rand
impacts.why: Monetary policy pause expectations stabilize short-term domestic yield expectations.
